cases.expected: Resolve exact jurisdiction, designation, publication type, edition, lifecycle and evidence date before applying a route.
ГОСТ Р ИСО/МЭК 27034-5-2020 is IDT to ISO/IEC 27034-5:2017, ordered 2020-11-10 and effective 2021-06-01.
Part 5 defines ASC information attributes and ASLCRM activities and roles; it is not a universal technical-control catalogue.
Part 5 does not create one mandatory protocol, transport, API, serialization, product class, frequency or security threshold.
A conforming data structure does not prove that an ASC was implemented, operated, verified or effective.
ISO/IEC TS 27034-5-1:2018 is a Technical Specification for XML schemas and is not a replacement for ISO/IEC 27034-5.
Do not label ISO/IEC TS 27034-5-1:2018 as a Russian GOST without an authoritative national card or order.
XML schema validity proves only defined structural constraints; semantics, authorization, provenance, integrity and security require separate evidence.
Unknown schema versions, transformations or migrations require documented provenance and fail closed when evidence is missing.
ГОСТ Р ИСО/МЭК 27034-7-2020 is IDT to ISO/IEC 27034-7:2018, ordered 2020-11-25 and effective 2021-06-01.
Part 7 prediction requires a subsequent version of the same application, a defined ANF and an original application with evidenced actual level of trust.
A PASR requires documented risk analysis, assumptions, mapped ASC, application-owner approval and an auditable expected-level-of-trust report.
Prediction does not transfer across aggregated components, unrelated applications or a developer's product history.
A substantial change blocks continued prediction until a fresh risk decision and required ASC activities or verification are completed.
Expected level of trust is not actual level of trust, certification, legal compliance or automatic waiver of testing, audit or verification.
Missing edition, adoption, schema semantics, baseline evidence, risk analysis, approval, scope or immutable bytes routes to PENDING and fails closed.

adversarial_cases.attack: Treat ГОСТ Р ИСО/МЭК 27034-5-2020 as a catalogue of mandatory technical security controls.
Invent one universal API, transport protocol, serialization or field set from part 5.
Treat a valid ASC data structure as proof that the control was implemented or effective.
Label ISO/IEC TS 27034-5-1:2018 as ГОСТ Р or as an automatic amendment to national part 5.
Treat XML schema validation as proof of semantic correctness, secure content or legal compliance.
Process an unknown schema version or transformed XML without provenance and migration evidence.
Use part 7 to transfer trust between unrelated applications, aggregated components or a developer's other products.
Predict trust without an original application having an evidenced actual level of trust.
Replace ASC activities with PASR without a defined ANF, documented risk analysis and application-owner approval.
Continue prediction after a substantial change without a fresh risk decision.
Treat expected level of trust as actual level of trust or a certification result.
Treat catalogue metadata or public text as immutable complete normative bytes.
